sections.heading: What is trending: “flights”
paragraphs: “flights” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for DE (snapshot taken 2026-11-12T11:06:09+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from CBS News, The Verge, WSJ. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Exclusive | United Airlines Is Banning AI Bots From Booking Flights” — WSJ
“United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers” — CBS News

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 12 Nov 2026 01:50:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-12T11:06:09+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-12T11:07:21+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
